subjects.pose: Stationary, fully outside the driving lane at the curb
subjects.action: Parked at the curb with its amber beacon flashing
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame as the ego vehicle approaches and passes; the beacon continues flashing throughout. No positional change of the truck itself.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car, seen implicitly through its forward-facing dashcam ego perspective

background_setting: A two-lane urban road under overcast daytime skies, flanked by curbs and modest low-rise buildings, streetlamps, and sparse roadside vegetation. The asphalt is dry and light gray, with faded lane markings dividing the two lanes. Parked cars and a tow truck occupy the right curb, and the road ahead is open and clear with no traffic signals, intersections, pedestrians, or lane obstructions. The horizon shows a flat, muted cityscape beneath uniform gray cloud cover.
